'''Malastare's western continent''' was the western continent of the planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. After the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]] was [[Gran Protectorate Act/Legends|established]] around [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], all unemployed [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]] on Malastare were forced to relocate to the western continent.<ref name="TEA" />
